host: developer Windows desktop, WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04.5, i7-10700K (8 cores / 16 threads), 31 GB visible; Python 3.12.3, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.14.1, pandas 2.2.3, gcc 13.3.0
workload: four-unit event-driven campaign, contract v4, sensor noise v0 seed 20260929, 2017 weather, scripted actions; seven-day prefixes
method: Per-worker stepping cost = (elapsed at day 7 - elapsed at day 1) / 6, which excludes model parsing and RHS compilation. Annual time projected by scaling the audited Tokyo annual run of the same code, seed and actions (results/noise_annual_progress.jsonl) by the ratio of per-day stepping over the same days. Assumes the early-crop parallel slowdown holds over the whole season; not yet checked with a parallel annual run.
caveats: The 16-worker batch spanned a host sleep of about 9.6 h (wall 35,025 s); per-worker figures use monotonic process time and are consistent across workers, but that level should be re-measured.
Excludes evaluation replicas, pilots, retries and LLM waiting time.
